SYNTHETIX is a decentralized protocol that issues synthetic assets, called Synths, which track the prices of other assets. SYNTHETIX operates on the Ethereum blockchain. SYNTHETIX uses collateral in its native SNX token to back the synthetic assets it issues. SYNTHETIX relies on price oracles to supply the market data used by its synthetic assets.

Uranium Finance is a decentralized exchange that operates on the Binance Smart Chain. Uranium Finance uses an automated market maker model in which liquidity is pooled in smart contracts. Uranium Finance was the target of a major exploit in 2021.

Spirit Swap is a decentralized exchange that operates on the Fantom blockchain. Spirit Swap uses an automated market maker model in which liquidity is pooled in smart contracts. Spirit Swap has its own governance and reward token, SPIRIT.

Opyn is a decentralized options protocol that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Opyn issues options as tokenized contracts that can be traded without a central intermediary. Opyn enables users to hedge risk and to create collateralized option positions through smart contracts.
